task.why_it_matters: git diff HIDES this - git normalises line endings when diffing, so the file reads as a small change or none, and only a byte compare shows it. I hit the identical defect twice today from `io.open(p, 'w', encoding='utf-8')` with no `newline=''`, which on Windows rewrites every line; it had turned _types/fields.tsv and a kit script CRLF and I caught it with cmp, not with diff. A publish of a flipped file commits the whole file and buries the real change.
task.what_is_blocked: NOTHING of mine. I excluded both files from my own publish rather than restoring them, because a differential dirty-check may report but must never revert a shared tree.
